acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Rotwalkers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Ghoul, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Sinew-Hook Pursuit Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A fresher, faster corpse with taut posture, exposed sinew running along the arms, hooked claw-hands, a clenched jaw, and burial clothes tight enough to reveal the loaded tendon route.

Signature mechanic: Carrion Draw: the Ghoul plants a hooked hand, cords the exposed sinew along both arms, and reels its fresher body into a jaw-first rush; a Shambler lying in the lane becomes an optional anchor that lengthens the pull but does not change its direction.
battlefieldDuty: Apply reliable pursuit by hooking one claw into terrain or a fallen body and using exposed arm sinew to slingshot through a short, fixed chase lane.
constructionDimensions: Materials remain corpse-native and unaffiliated: grey-green wet flesh, bruise-purple pooling, brown dried blood, bile staining, dirty burial linen, grave dirt, exposed sinew, and wet bone retain recognizable bodily provenance.

Motion and surface behavior stay plague-biological rather than elemental: tendon tension, joint slip, fluid seepage, fly movement, dragging cloth, embedded weapons, and stitched-body load transfer expose the active seam without a supernatural environmental wake.
counterplay: Break or displace the hooked hand, cross behind the planted shoulder, or interrupt the exposed tendon before the body releases; the Ghoul overshoots if its anchor vanishes late. Affinity signal: Dragging ankles, exposed tendon cords, open ribs, loaded corpse sutures, central faces, throne seams, and fly columns preserve each form's established weak point without elemental assistance.
forbiddenTreatments: Generic gore that hides which corpse seam, tendon, rib gap, or death wound carries the mechanic
identityInvariants: A recognizably human but wrong silhouette retains dislocated shoulders, a dragging or mismatched gait, a hanging jaw, and a head or torso held at an impossible angle.
Grey-green and bruise-purple flesh, dried-blood brown, bile yellow, and dirty linen white remain bodily and funerary rather than elemental colors.
Rotting flesh, exposed sinew, wet bone, grave dirt, torn burial clothing, and the visible marks or embedded tools of death preserve each corpse's material history.
Every form is wet and partly open, with readable seams at tendons, ribs, sutures, or fused bodies that explain both animation and counterplay.
Escalation reverses decay into coordination: sagging fragments become corded muscle, reinforced bone, cooperative corpse anatomy, and finally a plague court built from many still-legible bodies.
telegraph: One claw bites into floor, wall, or corpse, the arm sinew rises like cables, and the clenched jaw points straight down the chosen lane.
